Sectorally pharma/FMCG/realty bid; metal and PSU bank softer intraday in some wires.

fields.headline: RIL allots ₹12,000 Cr NCDs at 7.47%; JP Morgan India Conference meetings 21 Sep; Jio IPO timing still open
fields.summary: On 16 Sep 2026 RIL allotted 12 lakh PPD Series Q unsecured NCDs aggregating ₹12,000 Cr at 7.47% p.a., maturing 16 Sep 2031 (CRISIL/CARE AAA). Executives held JP Morgan India Conference one-on-ones in Mumbai on 21 Sep with no UPSI disclosed. Jio Platforms has SEBI DRHP observations (28 Aug) but November listing timing remains market rumor, not company-confirmed.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed large AAA NCD raise supports liquidity; IR meetings routine; treat Jio IPO calendar as rumored only.

unknowns: Exact Nov Jio IPO pricing/window not company-confirmed

fields.headline: TCS signs long-term AI/cloud infrastructure partnership with Germany’s Aareal Bank
fields.summary: NSE press filing dated 15 Sep 2026 confirms a long-term strategic partnership with Aareal Bank AG covering data-centre ops, cloud, workplace, cybersecurity and infrastructure under an AI-led delivery model. Contract value and tenure were not disclosed. Separate TOI report of a ~₹2,000 Cr Best Buy India GCC win remains source-attributed, not exchange-confirmed.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed strategic deal with EU bank; value undisclosed so strength capped at med; Best Buy item stays rumored.

unknowns: Aareal deal TCV undisclosed
Best Buy GCC win not exchange-confirmed

fields.headline: SBI advises customers ahead of UFBU nationwide bank strike 28–30 Sep 2026
fields.summary: On 21 Sep 2026 SBI issued a customer advisory ahead of a three-day United Forum of Bank Unions strike (28–30 Sep), noting branch disruption risk while ATMs, CSPs, YONO/UPI/digital channels are expected to remain available. Separately, media says SBI is in-principle anchor for Vi’s proposed funding package (primary for IDEA, secondary for SBI).
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed ops headline; digital buffers limit equity impact—low strength; Vi funding is not SBI equity catalyst.

unknowns: Strike actual branch closure intensity varies by location

fields.headline: BoB flags UFBU strike windows incl. 28–30 Sep; ₹6,000 Cr AT1/Tier-II programme remains approved
fields.summary: Bank of Baroda has disclosed union strike notices covering Sep 11, Sep 28–30 and further action from late Oct. Earlier in 2026 the board/CRC approved raising up to ₹6,000 Cr via AT1 and/or Tier II bonds (tranches through FY27), but no fresh Sep allotment filing was located in this pass.
fields.why_for_verdict: Strike is confirmed near-term ops noise; capital programme approved but not a fresh Sep issuance catalyst.

unknowns: No Sep 2026 AT1 allotment confirmation found in this research pass

fields.headline: PNB establishes $1.5 bn EMTN programme; Moody’s/Fitch/CareEdge ratings assigned mid-Sep
fields.summary: PNB informed exchanges that its USD 1.5 billion Euro Medium Term Note programme (set up 16 Sep 2026) received Moody’s (P)Baa3, Fitch BBB- and CareEdge BBB+/Stable on 17 Sep, disclosed 18 Sep. No tranche issuance yet. Bank also flagged possible disruption around UFBU strike dates.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed MTN platform and investment-grade-style ratings open FCY funding optionality; actual raise still pending.

unknowns: No EMTN tranche priced yet

fields.headline: Canara Bank raises ₹2,042 Cr via 8.10% Basel III AT1 bonds (allotment 18 Sep)
fields.summary: Canara Bank completed EBP bidding on 16 Sep 2026 for perpetual AT1 bonds (₹2,000 Cr base + ₹42 Cr greenshoe), raising ₹2,042 Cr at 8.10% coupon; deemed allotment/pay-in 18 Sep, proposed NSE listing, issuer call 18 Sep 2031.
fields.why_for_verdict: Fresh confirmed AT1 capital raise strengthens CET1/AT1 stack; coupon and size disclosed.

fields.headline: ONGC reports gas strike at deepwater MN-DW18-1 well off Odisha (Samudra Manthan)
fields.summary: Company statement covered by TOI: first Samudra Manthan well in Mahanadi Offshore Basin (~43 km off Odisha) flowed gas from 1,441–1,452 m interval after strike on 18 Sep 2026; drilled to 1,623 m. Monetisation subject to appraisal/commercial evaluation.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed discovery news; commercial reserves/size not yet proven—medium horizon, med strength.

unknowns: Commercial resource size and development timeline pending appraisal

fields.headline: NTPC group capacity to 91,164 MW after Gujarat RE CODs; Mouda 400 MWh BESS contract terminated
fields.summary: Exchange-linked disclosure (via NGEL, 18–19 Sep): 68.22 MW Dahod solar third-party capacity and 9.45 MW Vanki wind COD lift group installed capacity to 91,164 MW. Separately on 21 Sep reports, NTPC terminated GRIL’s ₹413.37 Cr Mouda BESS EPC for default and encashed ~₹91 Cr securities, with re-tender planned.
fields.why_for_verdict: Capacity adds are bullish for RE growth; BESS termination is ops/execution noise, not core generation hit.

fields.headline: POWERGRID approves up to ₹5,000 Cr 84th series private bond issue (10-year)
fields.summary: On 21 Sep 2026 POWERGRID approved issuance of its 84th bond series via private placement: base ₹1,000 Cr with ₹4,000 Cr greenshoe (up to ₹5,000 Cr / Rs 50 bn). Unsecured NCD, taxable, 10-year tenor with annual redemption from year 4; coupon via EBP bidding; proposed BSE/NSE listing.
fields.why_for_verdict: Routine confirmed funding approval; equity impact typically muted until deployment news.

unknowns: Coupon/final allotment size pending EBP

fields.headline: Reuters: ~40% of India’s coal plants at critically low fuel stocks as of mid-Sep
fields.summary: Reuters (21 Sep 2026) reported 74 coal-fired plants with critically low stocks amid monsoon/logistics strains, even as Coal India has highlighted monsoon supply efforts and higher Apr–Aug dispatches in other coverage. Narrative is sector/fuel-security overlay rather than a CIL-specific order win.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed sector stress can lift offtake urgency for CIL but also flags logistics risk; not a company deal catalyst.

unknowns: Plant-level stock data attributed to CEA-style datasets via Reuters; no CIL price guidance found

fields.headline: IOC board approves ₹2,448.70 Cr Kochi–Thoothukudi natural gas pipeline (424.65 km)
fields.summary: On 21 Sep 2026 IOC board gave investment approval for KTPL: estimated cost ₹2,448.70 Cr, length 424.65 km, system capacity 6.84 MMSCMD (incl. ≥1.71 MMSCMD common carrier), linking Kochi LNG terminal to southern TN/Kerala demand centres after PNGRB authorisation.
fields.why_for_verdict: Board-approved capex on gas midstream is confirmed positive for long-term gas network; construction timetable not in filing.

unknowns: Commissioning schedule/financing mix not disclosed in summaries reviewed

fields.headline: No fresh Sep 2026 IRFC deal filing located; last major raise was $1.1 bn JPY ECB (May 2026)
fields.summary: This research pass did not find a September 2026 exchange catalyst. Closest solid item: 21 May 2026 signing of five-year unsecured JPY ECB equivalent to $1.1 bn arranged by SBI, HDFC Bank, SMBC and DBS for railway/infra financing. FY27 borrowing-plan/loan-book commentary exists but is not a Sep event.
fields.why_for_verdict: Thin for DeskJob date—May ECB is confirmed but stale vs 21 Sep; treat as low-strength funding backdrop only.

unknowns: No Sep 2026 primary IRFC order/bond allotment found in WebSearch this pass
Exact INR equivalent of May ECB varies with FX

fields.headline: REC completes India’s first SEBI-sandbox tokenised corporate bond issue (~₹500 Cr @ 7.30%)
fields.summary: On 7 Sep 2026 REC said it raised ~₹500 Cr (base ~₹100 Cr + greenshoe ~₹400 Cr) in tokenised corporate bonds under SEBI Regulatory Sandbox; ~8x oversubscribed vs ~₹796 Cr bids; 7.30% coupon, tenor 1y9m; same-day pay-in/allotment/listing on NSE and BSE.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed innovative funding success; size modest vs loan book so strength med not high.

fields.headline: PFC–REC merger: Presidential consent already granted; scheme still needs remaining clearances
fields.summary: Presidential consent for merging REC into PFC was intimated around 10 Jun 2026; boards later approved a swap of 88 PFC shares per 100 REC. As of late Sep the combination still requires shareholder/creditor/regulatory steps; expected effectiveness often cited toward FY28 start subject to approvals. No fresh Sep bond allotment located beyond routine interest/redemption notices.
fields.why_for_verdict: Structural M&A path is officially advanced but not closed; Sep tape lacks a fresh PFC-only deal catalyst.

unknowns: Effective date and final regulatory path still open
No Sep 2026 primary PFC issuance catalyst found

fields.headline: BHEL–Titagarh 50:50 JV for 35-year maintenance of 80 Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets
fields.summary: Mid-Sep 2026 coverage: BHEL and Titagarh Rail Systems signed a 50:50 JV (proposed Delhi co., initial capital ₹50 lakh) to comprehensively maintain 80 Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets for 35 years, supporting their large IR manufacturing+AMC franchise (often cited ~₹24,000 Cr combined context in press).
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed JV formalises long AMC annuity around sleeper VB fleet; incremental equity surprise may be limited if order was previously known.

unknowns: Exact incremental AMC NPV vs prior contract disclosure not isolated in this pass

fields.headline: Wipro renews/extends AI-enabled Digital Workplace Services engagement with ABB
fields.summary: Wipro press release 1 Sep 2026: multi-year Digital Workplace Services contract with ABB extended, powered by Wipro Intelligence / AI Live Workspace / WINGS; deal was previously included in Wipro’s 16 Apr 2026 results release. Value not newly disclosed in the Sep note.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed renewal with industrial major; low strength because TCV undisclosed and already in prior bookings narrative.

unknowns: Contract value undisclosed

fields.headline: TPREL commissions 100 MW Kayathar group-captive solar; utility RE portfolio cited at 12.3 GW
fields.summary: Early Sep 2026 company/media releases: Tata Power Renewable Energy commissioned 100 MW group-captive solar at Kayathar, Tamil Nadu, taking utility portfolio to ~12.3 GW with operational capacity above 7 GW and ~5.3 GW under development (per company PR).
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed capacity COD supports RE scale story; single 100 MW add is incremental vs portfolio size.

fields.headline: YES Bank Q1 FY27 profit ₹1,071 Cr (+~34% YoY); capital-raise resolutions already shareholder-approved
fields.summary: Reported Q1 FY27 net profit ~₹1,071 Cr with improving asset-quality ratios in secondary wires; shareholders earlier backed board resolutions including a proposed up-to-₹16,000 Cr fund-raise envelope (equity+debt caps as disclosed at AGM). No fresh Sep 21 price-sensitive breakthrough filing isolated; avoid momentum hype.
fields.why_for_verdict: Earnings print is constructive but not a fresh 21 Sep breakout; capital raise is enabling, not executed—keep strength low.

unknowns: Exact Q1 release date/filing PDF not re-fetched this pass
FCNR mobilisation figures in secondary wires need primary confirmation before sizing

fields.headline: SBI-led lenders weighing ~₹35,000 Cr / $3.5 bn debt package for Vodafone Idea CapEx—still contingent
fields.summary: Bloomberg/CNBC-TV18-style wires in Sep: SBI said to be in-principle anchor (~₹7,000 Cr share cited in some reports) for a ~₹35,000 Cr consortium facility for network CapEx, with contours possibly finalising into Oct, subject to other banks, documentation, guarantees and promoter leadership conditions. Not a completed disbursement or company exchange confirmation of drawdown.
fields.why_for_verdict: Material if closed, but status is rumored/in-principle only—strictly not confirmed; high binary risk.

unknowns: No confirmed full consortium sanction+disbursement as of 21 Sep research
Guarantee/promoter conditions unresolved in press accounts

fields.headline: Suzlon wins maiden 200 MW wind EPC order from Ayana Renewable Power (Madhya Pradesh)
fields.summary: Exchange disclosure 8 Sep 2026: 200 MW order for 64× S144 3.15 MW turbines at Limbawas, MP, covering turbine supply, land, BoP, PSS, EHV, commissioning and O&M; S144 cumulative orders cross 10 GW milestone. Confirmed company filing—not a penny hype rumor.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed DevCo order with clear MW/scope; INR contract value not in disclosure—strength med, no hype.

unknowns: Order INR value not disclosed in exchange PR
